subjective.text: Sandra Bullock has been experiencing coughing for five days with nasal discharge.
She is currently diabetic and on medication for hypertension.
Her last blood pressure check was a while ago.
She has no known allergies to medications.
Sandra Bullock works as an office manager and lives with her partner and dog.
She drinks alcohol occasionally but does not smoke.
Her weight is stable at 65 kg and height is 5'5''.
Sandra Bullock has had a normal blood test for diabetes recently.
She mentions taking lemon sips to soothe her throat at night.
Her temperature is not checked regularly and she does not have a thermometer available.

objective.text: No chest pain or shortness of breath noted during examination.
Nose symptoms include constant nasal discharge without blood.
Coughing every twenty to thirty minutes with no phlegm or chest pain.
She feels hot but also chilly at times without fever.

assessment.text: Sandra Bullock likely has a viral chest infection with no signs of bacterial infection based on her symptoms and history.
She is advised to rest, stay hydrated, and return if not improving in a week or experiencing worsening symptoms.

plan.text: Continue current management of lemsip for cough relief; avoid paracetamol containing products.
Recommend Sandra Bullock to check her blood sugar regularly and have regular diabetes and blood pressure checks with her GP.
